parsed.internal_thinking: Gemini just placed her second settlement at node 23. Let me check: N[23] connects hexes [11,7,6]. H[11]=O3, H[7]=Wh8, H[6]=B10. So she gets ore-3, wheat-8, brick-10. That's 21 pips total with good diversity. She already had node 41 (O5, Wh9, B10 - 24 pips) and a road to 40. Now she's building a second cluster on the opposite side of the board. This is interesting: she's not connecting her settlements yet, so she's playing for two separate resource engines rather than longest road early. Her ore access is now doubled (two ore hexes). Wheat is also doubled. This is a strong, diversified position. She's not threatening my roads directly, but she's securing ore and wheat - resources I'll need. No immediate threat to my position, but I should note that Gemini is playing for resource security and flexibility, not early road pressure. She's being smart about it. My settlements at 20 and 25 are still fine; we're not competing directly for hexes. I should stay quiet - this is just setup, and she's making a reasonable play.
parsed.note_to_self: Gemini's second settlement at 23 (O3, Wh8, B10). She now has two ore sources (nodes 41 and 23) and two wheat sources. Not connecting them yet - playing for dual resource engines, not longest road. She's securing ore and wheat diversity. My position remains solid: 20 (W,B,S) + 25 (S,O,Wh) with port access at node 9. No direct conflict. Watch her next road placement to see if she connects 23 or expands elsewhere.
